subject: Post-call recap: demo + cadence alignment; introduce security & procurement
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morales <alex@paystream.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: demo + cadence alignment; introduce security & procurement

Hi Alex — great to meet this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- What we heard: PayStream wants a short proof-of-concept focused on latency, throughput, and SSO behavior when serving query-heavy analytics workloads. Primary success criteria: sub-200ms median p99 under a 50 RPS steady-state and smooth SSO walkthrough.

- Next step (proposal): 45-minute technical deep dive + sandbox demo where we run a small workload and walk through SSO. We’ll cover: architecture assumptions, KV/prefix caching, quantization recommendations, and a short Q&A for procurement/security.

Can you loop in the folks from security/procurement (CISO and procurement lead) so we can align evidence needs (SOC 2, data retention, audit logs) and calendar windows? To make scheduling easier, our team can do: 
  • Wed Dec 8, 10:00–10:45 AM ET (7:00–7:45 AM PT)
  • Thu Dec 9, 2:00–2:45 PM ET (11:00–11:45 AM PT)

Attached: redwood-demo-one-pager.pdf (overview), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (proposed agenda + owners). I’ll also share a short checklist for sandbox access once we lock a time.

Thanks — looping in Sean (platform demos / SSO) and Kim (procurement support).

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0127

(attachments: redwood-demo-one-pager.pdf [pdf], mutual-action-plan.xlsx [xlsx])

From: Alex Morales <alex@paystream.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@paystream.com>, Elena Cruz <ecruz@paystream.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 16:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: demo + cadence alignment; introduce security & procurement

Thanks Olga — appreciate the clear summary. Tom (CISO) and Elena (Procurement) are on copy. A couple of quick notes: 

- Tom: please see the success criteria above; our security org will want SOC 2 Type II evidence and a short list of the logging/retention guarantees we can expect.
- Elena: procurement will want prelim cost guidance and a high-level mutual action plan to share with our legal team.

Availability from our side looks like: 
  • Wed Dec 8, 10:00–10:45 AM ET — works for our infra/security leads
  • Thu Dec 9, 2:00–2:45 PM ET — fallback if Wed fills up

If you can confirm Wed Dec 8 10:00 ET, we’ll block time and share attendee list. Also, can you confirm whether Redwood needs any test SSO credentials ahead of the call, and if there’s a preferred SAML/OIDC flow to exercise?

Thanks,
Alex Morales
Head of Platform Integrations | PayStream Analytics
alex@paystream.com | +1 (212) 555-0789

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morales <alex@paystream.com>, Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@paystream.com>, Elena Cruz <ecruz@paystream.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: demo + cadence alignment; introduce security & procurement

Alex — perfect, Wed Dec 8 10:00 ET is available on our side. Confirming we’ll run a 45-min session: 20-min sandbox demo, 15-min SSO/technical Q&A, 10-min procurement/next steps. Calendar invite attached (calendar-invite.ics).

Quick checklist / asks so the session is productive:
  1) Security: if you can share the top 3 concerns (SOC 2 questions are obvious; if there are specific retention/compliance windows please flag) — Tom, any quick notes you can drop here are helpful.
  2) SSO: if you can provide a test SAML metadata URL or short-lived OIDC client, Sean will exercise it in the sandbox. If you prefer not to share credentials, we can demo with our sample IdP and walk through the flows.
  3) Procurement: Elena — if you have a preferred format for pricing/discounts (e.g., committed GPU pool vs hosted usage), we’ll tailor the mutual-action-plan accordingly.

I’ve re-attached the mutual action plan and added a first-draft owner column for Redwood. We’ll create a shared Drive folder for artifacts and a short demo prep doc (demo-environment-checklist.docx) so we can collect SSO metadata and sample queries ahead of the call.

Sean — can you pick this up on the SSO prep? Kim — will you own procurement follow-up and any preliminary pricing notes during the call?

Onward — I’ll send the calendar invite once you confirm attendees.

Best,
Olga

> On Tue, Nov 30, 2027 at 4:18 PM Alex Morales <alex@paystream.com> wrote:
> > Thanks Olga — appreciate the clear summary. Tom (CISO) and Elena (Procurement) are on copy. ...

(attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx [xlsx], calendar-invite.ics [ics])

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Alex Morales <alex@paystream.com>, Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@paystream.com>, Elena Cruz <ecruz@paystream.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: demo + cadence alignment; introduce security & procurement

Thanks — I’ll own the SSO portion. Quick notes:

- Preferred approach: if PayStream can provide SAML metadata or an OIDC test client ahead of time, we’ll run an authentication exercise in the sandbox before the call so the live demo focuses on token flow + performance. If not, we’ll do a live walkthrough with our sample IdP.
- I’ve uploaded a short prep doc to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/demo-prep-PS-2027-044/demo-environment-checklist.docx — it lists the minimal artifacts (SAML metadata, sample user, key rotation cadence) we’ll need.
- Kimberly will cover procurement/pricing during the last 10 minutes.

I’ll send the calendar invite (Wed Dec 8, 10:00 ET) with the Zoom link and a short agenda. Looking forward to it.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Platform Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com

(related link: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/demo-prep-PS-2027-044, attachment stub: demo-environment-checklist.docx)
